title: Art Rock
tagline: Rock music that treats arrangement, ideas, and form as creative material.
summary: Art rock expands rock's basic band format with unusual structures, conceptual themes, and influences from experimental or classical music. It can be elaborate or minimal, but it typically treats the album and performance as spaces for deliberate artistic choices. The term covers many generations of musicians who use rock as a starting point rather than a boundary.

pillars.name: The Velvet Underground
pillars.why: The Velvet Underground brought avant-garde influence and urban subject matter into a stark, influential rock format.

pillars.name: Roxy Music
pillars.why: Roxy Music combined experimental arrangements with carefully constructed songs and a distinctive visual identity.

pillars.name: David Bowie
pillars.why: David Bowie used rock as a platform for reinvention, character, and adventurous studio work.
